description: Agent Learning: submit the learning report written for the principal, with the lesson records behind it: its title, its audience, the period it covers and its text, read for wording such as learns from every mistake, never repeats an error or 100% retained; for the lessons captured, validated, adopted, applied and retained, whether the report states them, how many it names and whether each figure links to the records behind it; and optionally the record of lessons captured, validated, adopted, applied and retained in the period. The signed report gives the report with any unlimited learning wording, each figure with whether it is stated, its count and whether it is backed by the records, and the record with the adopted lessons not applied and not retained, and names a report that inflates the record of learning: figures above the record, figures with no link to the records behind them, and wording such as learns from every mistake while the record holds adopted lessons not applied or not retained; then figures left out of the report and figures below the record, with the fix for each. This reports on the agent’s own learning against its lesson records: a feedback summary is wever_feedback-report-check, a knowledge report is wever_knowledge-report-check, a kept-promises report is wever_commitment-report-check and an uncertainty report is wever_uncertainty-report-check. Verdict report_inflated, report_incomplete, report_missing or learning_report_sound. POST /api/learning-report-check. Reads only the recorded episodes, lessons and records in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no lesson is written, changed or retired and no memory or model is updated. Agent Learning reads whether an agent improves from its own experience, from the lessons it captures to the lessons it keeps: it is not the loop on feedback received (whether outside feedback was incorporated, the wever_feedback checks; learning begins where that ends and reads the agent’s own lesson records over time), not a knowledge store (stored knowledge and its retrieval, the wever_knowledge checks; learning is improvement from experience), not memory design (how memory is structured, wever_memory-design-check; this family reads what the lessons in it are worth), not the confidence an agent states in its answers (the wever_uncertainty checks) and not the promises it makes (the wever_commitment checks). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-learning-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-learning/.
